response.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT fundflux, project_count, AVG(project_count * 1.0) OVER () AS average_count, SUM(project_count) OVER () AS total_count FROM source_counts) SELECT fundflux, project_count, project_count * 1.0 / total_count AS share, project_count - average_count AS exceeds_average FROM totals WHERE project_count > average_count

assumptions.assumption: A NULL fundflux forms one funding-source group.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude projects whose funding source is unknown.
alternatives.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT fundflux, project_count, AVG(project_count * 1.0) OVER () AS average_count, SUM(project_count) OVER () AS total_count FROM source_counts) SELECT fundflux, project_count, project_count * 1.0 / total_count AS share, project_count - average_count AS exceeds_average FROM totals WHERE project_count > average_count
